data.one_liner: Generate video thumbnails using native platform APIs
data.what_it_does: Creates a thumbnail image from a video file. It supports saving to a file or returning raw bytes, with optional seeking to a specific time.
use_when: Need a quick thumbnail for a video preview
avoid_when: Running on Linux without FFmpeg installed
Using very old iOS or macOS targets below 16/13
strengths: Native API usage gives fast, high‑quality thumbnails
Supports multiple platforms (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux)
Optional seeking to arbitrary time positions
weaknesses: Linux requires external FFmpeg and libjpeg libraries
No built‑in caching or image manipulation beyond size/quality
data.setup_notes: On Linux install libavformat, libavcodec, libavutil, libswscale and libjpeg. No build_runner or codegen needed.
